dedupe_keys.name: infrastructures and assets inventory maps for iceland natalie case study 7

description: This dataset is a set of geospatial shapefiles forming the infrastructure and asset inventory maps for Iceland developed in case study 7 of the EU NATALIE project on nature-based solutions for climate resilience. The 31 zipped layers cover health and emergency facilities (hospitals, doctors, dentists, pharmacies, nursing homes, ambulance, fire and police stations), transport (airfields, harbours, ferry and bus stations, underground tunnel points), utilities and industry (power substations, telecom towers, wastewater treatment plants, reservoirs, oil storage, petrol stations, an aluminium factory, fish processing and factory harbours), aquaculture areas, supermarkets, schools and government buildings, together with 2 m and 6 m coastal flood layers and statistical areas. It was deposited on Zenodo by the University of Exeter in July 2025 and is downloadable (about 14 MB) under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the Zenodo record gives no source, date or attribute description for each layer, so completeness and positional accuracy are unknown, and the two coastal flood layers are scenario extents, not modelled events. It is useful for hazard exposure and cascading failure analysis of coastal communities, emergency response planning and climate adaptation studies in Iceland; a related record is the Open Infrastructure Map.
name: Infrastructures and assets inventory maps for Iceland (NATALIE case study 7)
